scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Let’s start by clearly defining the requirements. First, we should figure out what features we need and what users want to do before diving into development.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Requirements definition! That makes sense—it’s better to be clear about what we’re making first♪

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: But... when building an app, what kinds of things should we be thinking about?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: We start by clarifying: 'who' is going to use it, 'for what purpose,' and 'how' they’ll use it. Let’s think about the target users and their use cases first, and then define the features.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: I see! That definitely sounds better than just jumping into coding without a plan♪

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Megumi’s really getting the mindset of development. Nice job, requirements definition!!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: The two of them continued discussing requirement definition techniques and the basics of app design. Their structured approach was starting to pay off.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Thanks to you, {{playerName}}-senpai, I’m starting to understand the whole app development process♪ It feels reassuring to organize everything first!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Now that we’ve nailed down the requirements, let’s move on to implementation. Want to try writing some code together, Megumi?

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yes! I’d love to try. But... can we work somewhere a little more focused?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: I’m so glad Megumi’s feeling motivated. At this rate, we’re going to make a great app.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: A perfect chance to be alone together! Where should you work?

options.text: In Nara Park, surrounded by nature
